text.name: Staff of Wizardry
text.description:
{Staff of Wizardry}

Reduces enemy spell damage resistance by half.
text.event: A crowd of peasants stopped you with a request to judge their dispute. Should they plant beans or spinach? ''The solution here is simple,'' you say. ''If you can't stand spinach, then plant some beans!'' As a reward, they gave you an old staff, which they dug up in their field. They had no idea that it was the Staff of Wizardry!
